text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~... So delicious!!
Limited edition mango Hachimi drink!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This is what it's all about, after all!!
The ultimate reward for giving it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“—And so,
that Hachimi is a souvenir for you!”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~. It's a reward for Trainer-san and a token of my gratitude for everything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's overflowing smile
showed just how fulfilling her day off had been.
